source.title: Output Area 2022 Total Population
source.referenceDateBasis: 2022 Census reference day, established by the pinned Settlement source descriptor and official census metadata.
source.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 per publication page; preserve NRS/Crown attribution. Index retains its existing NRS/applicable PAF notices.
source.unit: published usual-resident persons per 2022 Output Area
precisionLimitations: Published source integer cells; not individual residence truth or a 2024 locality estimate.
Totals below mean exact sums of this table; no separately published Scotland/council headline total was acquired or forced into reconciliation.
General census disclosure-control documentation does not by itself establish the treatment of each cell in this particular CSV.

index.councilCodeVintage: Council Area 2019 (CA2019), exactly matched to current frozen 2024 council Places through existing code continuity entries.
index.localityNameEncoding: Windows-1252 as in frozen builder; names never join keys.
index.missingLocalityRepresentation: Empty string in CLOC2022; a genuine outside-locality category, not zero population.
